title: fixtures-vibes skips file
description: Every canonical scenario a runtime does not pass must be listed here with a reason. Unknown IDs, duplicate entries and skips for scenarios that now pass are failures.

fixturesVibes.description: fixtures-vibes tag or commit these skips were reviewed against.

reason.description: capability-absent: requires a capability the profile does not claim. intentional-divergence: product decision, needs owner sign-off. not-implemented: planned work. environment-limit: cannot run headless/CI (e.g. physical device). known-defect: failing bug, issue required.

issue.description: Issue/PR URL; required for not-implemented and known-defect.
